description.value: The Dawson Creek Municipal Library is a full-service public library serving the northeastern corner of British Columbia, offering an extensive physical collection of books, DVDs, and magazines alongside a robust digital lending program. It provides free computer and internet access to the public and maintains a community information hub with local recreation and tourism links. For touring cyclists passing through Dawson Creek — gateway to the Alaska Highway — the library offers a welcoming indoor rest stop with connectivity.

address.value: 1001 McKellar Avenue, Dawson Creek BC V1G 4W7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the library is active (events listed into 2026, updated hours shown in the header) and corroborates OSM contact details (phone, address, website all match). The website lists 'Computer & Internet' as a named service with a dedicated policy page, and OSM carries internet_access=wlan, together providing reasonable grounds to confirm Wi-Fi; no other cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags, so those remain null.
concerns: Donations page refers to the institution as 'Dawson Creek Public Library' rather than 'Dawson Creek Municipal Library' — minor internal name inconsistency on the library's own website, not considered a material discrepancy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A public library in a major northern BC cycling hub (Dawson Creek / Alaska Highway Mile 0 corridor) is a legitimate and useful stop for touring cyclists; confirmed active, publicly accessible, and offering free Wi-Fi.

blurb: Dawson Creek's public library, blocks from Mile 0 of the Alaska Highway.
